analysis.reasonEn:
RSI remains at 47.8 in neutral territory, ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 21.4. Volume ratio above 1.0 for 5 consecutive days indicates sustained volatility but a lack of clear direction.
The price is consolidating between the swing support at $350.06 and resistance at $359.49.
This follows 3 consecutive sessions of a wait-and-see stance.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($355.14) vs SMA5 ($350.93)/SMA20 ($353.78)/SMA50 ($372.67): below short-term and mid-term trends, below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($385.84)/SMA200 ($366.26): below long-term and very long-term trends.

· MACD histogram trajectory (1.2182→0.9598) + holding steady assessment + no trend reversal signal.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($350.06) + basis (moving average based).
· Swing resistance ($359.49) + potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day high ($361.86)/low ($343.29), 20-day high ($372.70)/low ($335.81): Higher Low pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.21x) + normal reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + wait-and-see conditions met.
